props.name: status
props.description: The step the shipment has reached. Every earlier step counts as complete.

props.name: timestamps
props.description: When each reached step happened. Steps without one show no time.

props.name: orderNumber
props.description: Order reference shown in the header — "A-10482".

props.name: trackingNumber
props.description: Carrier tracking number, with a copy button.

props.name: trackingUrl
props.description: Carrier tracking page. Makes the number a link.

props.name: estimatedDelivery
props.description: Expected delivery date, shown until the order is delivered.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override step names, for another language or wording.
